component.name: AppTile
component.script:
' Tiles get reused as the grid scrolls, so every tile resets the name bar. ' Only the My Channel tile sets shortDescriptionLine1, which shows the owner's name under its image. sub init() m.top.scaleRotateCenter = [160, 120] m.glow = m.top.findNode("glow") showFocus() end sub
sub showContent() item = m.top.itemContent logo = m.top.findNode("logo") if Left(item.HDPosterUrl, 8) = "https://" then logo.loadingBitmapUri = "pkg:/images/app_family_tiny.jpg" logo.failedBitmapUri = "pkg:/images/app_family_tiny.jpg" else logo.loadingBitmapUri = "" logo.failedBitmapUri = "" end if logo.uri = item.HDPosterUrl name = item.shortDescriptionLine1 hasName = (name <> invalid and name <> "") m.top.findNode("bar").visible = hasName m.top.findNode("name").visible = hasName if hasName then logo.height = 170 m.top.findNode("name").text = name else logo.height = 216 end if end sub
' Focused tile grows a little, gets a cherry-red glow, and the rest dim slightly. sub showFocus() fp = m.top.focusPercent if not m.top.gridHasFocus then fp = 0 s = 1.0 + 0.06 * fp m.top.scale = [s, s] m.glow.opacity = fp m.top.opacity = 0.8 + 0.2 * fp end sub
